title: 古木寒泉圖（1997.102）
title_orig: Old Trees by a Wintry Brook
holder: 克利夫兰美术馆（藏品号 1997.102）
medium: hanging scroll, ink and light color on paper
one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「1551」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: Old Trees by a Wintry Brook
hanging scroll, ink and light color on paper
Bequest of Mrs. A. Dean Perry

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → ming；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Naitō, Torajirō 內藤虎次郎. Min shitaika gafu [明四大家畫譜 = Paintings by the four great masters of the Ming dynasty]. Osaka: Hakubundō, 1924.（p. 50）
Sirén, Osvald. A History of Later Chinese Painting. London: The Medici Society, 1938.（Mentioned and Reproduced:  I, 110, pl. 78, and Lists, 241）
Sirén, Osvald. Kinas konst under tre årtusenden. Stockholm: Natur och kultur, 1942.（Mentioned and Reproduced: p. 525, fig. 486）
Sirén, Osvald. Chinese Painting: Leading Masters and Principles. New York: Ronald Press, 1956.（Mentioned and Reproduced: IV, 184, and VI, pl. 211-B, and VII, Lists, 260）

Masterpieces of Asian Art in American Collections II; An Offering of Treasures Celebrating the Tenth Anniversary of Asia House Gallery. New York: Distributed by New York Graphic Society, 1970.（cat. no. 42）
**馆方记录另有 8 条著录未在此列出。**

dating.text: 馆方著录中有含纪年的款识（见「题跋与鉴藏」一节），其年份与馆方断代一致，故断代依据可以填「款识」而不再是无从得知。**只给「较可靠」不给「确证」**：本库未核对原件，款识本身的真伪、是否后添均未独立判定。
款识原文未经本库目验；馆方亦未说明其对该款识真伪的判断。

colophons.text:
辛亥五月望徵明戲寫古木寒泉 時年八十二 [印] 徵明; 停雲

馆方英译：Artist's inscription, signature, and 2 seals: 

In the fifteenth day of the fifth month, the year of xinhai [1551], [I], Zhengming, playfully sketched this Old Trees by a Wintry Brook at eighty-two [sui]. [seals] Zhengming; Tingyun.
2 additional seals of Mou Yueqi 繆曰芑 (18th century).
以上为克利夫兰美术馆藏品记录里的题跋与钤印著录，**本库未核对原件**；款印的真伪、题跋者身份与年代均未独立判定。

provenance.text: (Jean-Pierre Dubosc [1904–1988], Paris, France, sold to Mr. and Mrs. A. Dean Perry)
A. [Albert] Dean Perry [1909-1987] and Helen Wade Greene Perry [1911-1996], Cleveland, OH, bequest to the Cleveland Museum of Art
The Cleveland Museum of Art, Cleveland, OH

reception.text: 展览史照录自馆方档案，**本库未核对展览图录原件**；仅现行档案（current）部分，馆方标为 legacy 的旧记录未收。
